question: Is Salesloft Cadence still relevant in 2027?
answer:
## Direct Answer

YES, Salesloft Cadence remains relevant in 2027 - but its STANDALONE value decays sharply. Cadence survives by becoming the WORKFLOW SUBSTRATE for AI agents (humans-in-the-loop orchestration), the DATA INTEGRATION LAYER for Salesloft''s AI stack, and the ENTERPRISE PROCESS ENGINE that AI-natives can''t replicate at scale. Net: Cadence-as-product fades; Cadence-as-platform wins. The 4 evolution paths + threats to Cadence relevance + comparable workflow product evolutions + 2027 success metrics.

## The 4 Cadence Evolution Paths

- **Path 1: Workflow substrate for AI agents** - Cadence becomes the orchestration layer humans use to deploy/monitor AI sequencers
- **Path 2: Data integration layer** - Activity-graph data piped into Sentence AI + Cadence AI feature stack
- **Path 3: Enterprise process engine** - 100+ rep customers need governance + permissions + audit; AI-natives can''t match
- **Path 4: Bundle anchor** - Cadence drives Drift + Sentence AI + future Lavender attach math

## Path 1: Workflow Substrate

- **2024-25 Cadence**: Sequence engine where AEs build/edit/run cadences
- **2026 Cadence**: Sequence builder + AI co-pilot suggestions (Sentence assistant)
- **2027 Cadence**: AI-orchestrated sequences with human-in-the-loop checkpoints
- **Substrate role**: Humans review + approve + override what the AI sequencer does
- **Defensible position**: AI-natives skip the human layer; Cadence wins where compliance/governance required
- **Example**: Bank pharma legal vetted sequences; AI suggests, human approves, Cadence executes

## Path 2: Data Integration Layer

- **Activity-graph corpus**: 12-18 months of sequence response, buyer engagement, multi-touch data per customer
- **Cadence as data hub**: All sequence data flows through Cadence; Sentence AI trains on it
- **Customer-specific AI**: AI knows YOUR pipeline patterns, YOUR ICP signals, YOUR sales cycle
- **AI-native gap**: Lavender, Apollo AI start with zero customer-specific data; need 6-12mo to compound
- **Cadence becomes**: The pipe between customer data and AI insights/actions

## Path 3: Enterprise Process Engine

- **Enterprise requirements**: 100+ rep customers need permission tiers, audit trails, regulatory compliance
- **Cadence governance features**: Sequence approvals, cooling-off rules, content review workflows
- **AI-native limitations**: Lavender, 11x ship for SMB/mid-market; enterprise governance underdeveloped
- **Cadence wins enterprise**: 70-80% of sub-segment in Salesloft 5,200-customer base
- **Vista discipline preserves**: Enterprise process features defended even under cost-out

## Path 4: Bundle Anchor

- **Cadence + Drift**: $135-185 ARPU; conversation+sequencing combo
- **Cadence + Sentence AI**: $145-200 ARPU; sequencing+AI assistant combo
- **Cadence + Lavender (post-acquisition)**: $165-220 ARPU; sequencing+AI email
- **Cadence + Drift + Sentence + Lavender (full stack)**: $200-285 ARPU
- **Anchor role**: Cadence is the must-have; Drift/Sentence/Lavender are attach products

## Threats To Cadence Relevance

- **Threat 1: AI agents replace cadences** - 11x autonomous SDR makes AE-built sequences obsolete
- **Threat 2: HubSpot Breeze native sequencing** - free/included in HubSpot CRM upsell
- **Threat 3: Apollo bottom-up commoditization** - cheap AI sequencing pulls SMB/mid-market down
- **Threat 4: Pure AI email tools** - Lavender + similar make sequence engine feel old
- **Threat 5: Conversation-driven workflow** - Drift + Gong-style insights replace traditional cadence model
- **Threat 6: Foundation model APIs** - Anthropic/OpenAI APIs let any tool build cadence-equivalent

## Comparable Workflow Product Evolutions

- **Marketo Engage 2018-24**: Marketing automation evolved from email engine to AI orchestration platform
- **Pardot/Marketing Cloud Account Engagement**: Salesforce''s B2B marketing engine; survived as platform substrate
- **HubSpot Workflows 2018-26**: From rule-based automation to AI-first; bundled into Hub stack
- **Outreach Sequences 2024-27**: Sequence engine + Smart Email Assist + Kaia conversation intelligence
- **Pattern**: Workflow products survive by evolving into AI-orchestrated platforms; pure-rule engines become irrelevant

## What Salesloft Wins By 2027 (Bull Case)

- **Cadence + Sentence AI ships H2 FY26** - AI co-pilot integrated into sequence builder
- **Cadence + Lavender (post-acquisition) integrated H2 FY26** - AI email layer adds to Cadence
- **70-80% Cadence retention rate** - core product survives AI-native onslaught
- **$145-200 ARPU steady-state** with bundle attach math working
- **Enterprise process engine market lead** - 70-80% market share in 100+ rep segment
- **Cadence becomes the workflow substrate** for AI agents in regulated industries

## What Kills Cadence (Bear Case)

- **AI agents replace cadences entirely** - 11x + similar make AE-built sequences obsolete by 2028
- **Salesloft fails to ship AI co-pilot timely** - Cadence feels old next to Outreach Smart Email Assist
- **HubSpot Breeze native sequencing** wins SMB/mid-market - Cadence locked out below 50 reps
- **Cadence retention drops to 50-60%** - core product erodes under competitive pressure
- **ARPU compresses to $85-115** - bundle attach math fails

## A Markdown Table - Cadence Evolution Path

| Year | Cadence role | ARPU | Retention | Differentiator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2024 | Sequence engine | $130-160 | 88-92% | Workflow rules |
| 2025 | Sequence + AI co-pilot beta | $130-160 | 87-91% | Salesloft brand + HubSpot ecosystem |
| 2026 | Sequence + Sentence AI integrated | $145-200 | 85-90% | Activity-graph data + AI co-pilot |
| 2027 | Workflow substrate for AI agents | $165-220 | 82-88% | Enterprise governance + bundle |
| 2028 | AI-orchestrated platform | $200-285 | 78-85% | Full stack with Lavender |

## A Mermaid Diagram - Cadence Relevance Through 2027

```mermaid
graph LR
  A["2024 Cadence: Sequence engine"] --> B["2025: Sentence AI co-pilot beta"]
  B --> C["2026 H2: Sentence AI integrated"]
  C --> D["2027 H1: Workflow substrate for AI agents"]
  D --> E["2027 H2: Lavender integrated"]
  E --> F["2028: Full AI-orchestrated platform"]
  G["Threats"] --> H["11x agentic SDR"]
  G --> I["HubSpot Breeze"]
  G --> J["AI commoditization"]
  H -.threatens.-> D
  I -.threatens.-> D
  J -.threatens.-> E
```

## Bottom Line

Salesloft Cadence remains relevant in 2027 - but evolves from sequence-engine to workflow-substrate for AI agents. Four evolution paths: workflow substrate, data integration layer, enterprise process engine, bundle anchor. Cadence survives by hosting AI orchestration with human-in-the-loop governance, NOT by competing as standalone sequence engine. Bull case: 70-80% retention, $145-200 ARPU, enterprise process engine lead. Bear case: 50-60% retention if AI agents replace cadences entirely. Net: Cadence-as-product fades; Cadence-as-platform wins. (See also: q1846, q1848, q1849, q1850)
